signature_moves: Heading-level gutter badges — small grey 'H1'/'H3' tags in the editor's left margin marking each markdown heading in place (the memorable, on-brand-for-Markdown move)
Warm paper two-tone — off-white warm chrome (#F8F7F5 / #F3F3F0) framing a pure-white content column; reads editorial/paper where stock macOS reads neutral grey
Muted steel-blue selection + matching link blue (#5E9DC0) — a calm bookish house accent deliberately not the vivid system blue
defects: Contrast Dilution — white label on #5E9DC0 selection fill ~2.7:1 (below 4.5:1); '+ Add property' and right-toolbar glyphs ~<3:1; fix by darkening the fill or using light accent-tinted fill with dark text

Non-native tell (minor) — inspector section headers STATS/TASKS/OUTLINE are tracked UPPERCASE (web/iOS micro-header convention) while the sidebar header 'Notes' correctly uses title-case; grammar is inconsistent between panes

Selection grammar deviation — solid saturated fill + white text (System-Settings house style) in a custom brand hue rather than the general light accent-tinted fill with accent-coloured text bound to the system accent

aesthetic.direction: Warm editorial / paper-toned product UI — Editorial-literary surface treatment (warm paper, restrained) applied to a native notes app, with a bookish muted accent instead of a techy electric one

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect — warm paper palette + generous spacing raise perceived usability/quality; the app's own pitch ('Beautifully Designed') banks on this first-contact halo
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (processing fluency) — grey labels vs dark values, muted counts, quiet chrome let primary content anchor attention
Von Restorff / signal detection — the single saturated selection is the one different element, kept findable by restraint elsewhere (though its ~2.7:1 contrast weakens the very signal it relies on)
Miller/Cowan chunking — sidebar chunked into ~5 nav rows + a 'Notes' group; inspector chunked STATS/TASKS/OUTLINE, holding each region within working-memory limits
Jakob's Law — conventional three-pane notes layout (sidebar / editor / inspector) matches the Bear/Craft/Notion mental model; conventional interface, differentiated product
notes: Single input is a marketing COVER COMPOSITE: one app-window screenshot embedded in a landing page (no standalone shots, meta.json gallery empty). Window is scaled down in the composite (~1.2x effective; traffic-light vs row measurements inconsistent ±20%) so ALL metrics are (estimated) with wide ranges, never (measured), and colours may carry slight composite shift. Only the app window is native evidence; the surrounding serif-display headline, sticker chips, black pill nav and monospace Homebrew command are BRAND evidence (recorded in the app profile, excluded from macOS canon). Lineage native at med confidence — density/traffic-lights/SF-Pro favour AppKit/SwiftUI but a well-built Electron/Tauri can't be excluded from one shot. Only light mode seen; no dark mode, settings, empty-state, search field, or focus state. First candidate for a 'warm-editorial-writing' cluster (Bear/Craft register) — needs 2+ more members before any promotion.
